metadata.verified_from: P&ID source pages (page_1.png through page_7.png) + ChromaDB chunk inspection
metadata.methodology: Gold chunk = chunk that must appear in top-K for the question to be answerable. answer_in_chunk flags whether the answer actually exists in the chunk (retrieval correct != always answerable due to extraction gaps).

questions.question: What type of equipment is V-101 and what is its service?
questions.ground_truth: V-101 is a High Pressure Separator (horizontal vessel) for oil/gas separation service
questions.notes: Verified from page 3 title block and page 1 PFD

questions.question: What is C-104 and what service does it provide?
questions.ground_truth: C-104 is a Gas Compressor providing gas compression service with capacity 0.50 MMSCFD
questions.notes: Verified from page 6 title block

questions.question: What is H-105?
questions.ground_truth: H-105 is the Compressor Discharge Cooler (Trim: B) for gas cooling service, receiving gas from C-104
questions.notes: Verified from page 6 spec block

questions.question: What safety valve protects V-101 from overpressure?
questions.ground_truth: PSV-101, a Pressure Safety Valve providing over-pressure protection
questions.notes: Verified from page 3 and chunk instrument list

questions.question: What is the setpoint of PSV-102?
questions.notes: Verified from chunk content: PSV-102 setpoint 75 PSIG

questions.question: What is the setpoint of PSV-103?
questions.notes: Verified from chunk content: PSV-103 set 2200 PSIG

questions.question: Where does the gas outlet of V-101 go?
questions.ground_truth: To the Gas Compressor (labelled TO GAS COMPRESSOR on the diagram) via 8-inch Class D line
questions.notes: Chunk has 'TO GAS COMPRESSOR' (not C-104 tag). Verified from page 3.

questions.question: What is the liquid outlet destination of V-101?
questions.ground_truth: To the LP Separator (labelled TO L.P. SEPARATOR on diagram) via 4-inch Class D line
questions.notes: Chunk has 'TO L.P. SEPARATOR'. Verified from page 3.

questions.question: What feeds into P-103?
questions.ground_truth: P-103 receives liquid from the LP Separator via a 4-inch Class A line
questions.notes: Verified from page 5 and chunk connections

questions.question: What is the motor horsepower of C-104?
questions.notes: 73 HP visible on page 6 spec block but NOT extracted into C-104 chunk — extraction gap. Tests: retrieval correct but LLM cannot answer.

questions.question: What is the liquid residence time of V-102?
questions.notes: Verified from page 4 spec block; V-102 chunk has '5 MIN liquid residence time'

questions.question: What equipment receives gas from C-104 after compression?
questions.ground_truth: H-105 (Compressor Discharge Cooler) receives gas directly from C-104
questions.notes: C-104 chunk shows 'Outlet: to H-105'. H-105 chunk shows 'Inlet: from C-104'. Verified from page 6.
